metadata.article_title: Exercise of power in appeal from order made in execution of decree.

article.title: Exercise of power in appeal from order made in execution of decree.
article.content:
8Exercise of power in appeal from order made in execution of decree.

Order 41, Rule 8
The powers conferred by rules 5 and 6 shall be exercisable where an appeal may be or has been preferred not from the decree but from an order made in execution of such decree.
